title: Factorized endpoint Views for reusable flow maps
hypothesis: Factorized Mirror endpoint coordinates over one shared two-time flow-map basis can recover held-out interval maps and preserve semigroup composition with lower actual inference bytes than native Flow Map Matching time conditioning, while outperforming a byte-matched additive endpoint factor control.
physical_object: Shared matrix-valued flow-map basis for the two-time transport operator.
mirror_coordinate: m(s,t) = U[start_index] elementwise-multiplied by V[end_index], linearly decoded to shared flow-map basis coefficients.
logical_multiplicity: One logical transport map for every ordered interval pair on a fixed 21-point time grid, including held-out interval pairs.

random_selection.selection_rule: registry rows priority=P0 AND status=UNTESTED; exclude every ID with any remote research/ma-* branch; numeric ID order

controls: Native FMM two-time conditioned flow-map MLP receiving state x and endpoints (s,t)
Native shared-basis FMM coefficient network: direct two-time conditioning of the same shared flow-map basis
Additive endpoint factors U[s]+V[t] decoded into the same shared flow-map basis
Independent full 2x2 matrix per interval (seen-interval upper control; held-out score N/A)

development.selection_metric: held-out interval map MSE, subject to native-FMM quality, additive-control specificity, semigroup and bytes gates
development.allowed_tuning: endpoint rank in {2,4,8} and equal optimizer update budget in {200,500}; all methods receive the selected update budget.

fresh.locked_interval_pairs: same 12 held-out endpoint pairs as development

data.generator: Synthetic non-autonomous linear ODE dx/dt=(A0+sin(2*pi*t)*A1)x, with noncommuting 2x2 matrices drawn per world; true interval maps are integrated with fixed RK4 step 0.002. Time grid has 21 endpoints from 0 through 1 at spacing 0.05.

paid_objects: all endpoint factor tables and coefficient decoder

compute.report_active_compute_proxy: forward MACs per sample times examples and updates; training estimate uses 3x forward proxy
compute.report_nfe: one learned map evaluation for direct s-to-t; two for a two-segment composition
compute.semigroup: report heldout composition versus true flow and model semigroup discrepancy

development_gate: Freeze the lowest equal update budget then rank meeting all on both development worlds: Mirror heldout map MSE <= 1.10x native FMM; <=0.80x additive endpoint control; normalized semigroup discrepancy <=0.01; and full serialized payload <=70% native FMM.
success_gate: All three fresh worlds meet the four development gates at the frozen settings. Direct-map NFE must remain 1 and the two-segment composition NFE 2. Report quality, bytes, compute and runtime separately.
failure_gate: If no development setting meets all gates, record development FAIL and do not open fresh. If any fresh world fails, final classification FAIL; no fresh tuning or retries.
boundaries: Synthetic linear ODE mechanism only; no image FID, diffusion checkpoint or real-world FMM claim.
Endpoint coordinates live on a fixed discrete time grid; no claim about arbitrary continuous endpoint interpolation.
NFE counts one learned interval-map call; the map is not compared with a native ODE solver at equal NFE.
Independent interval matrices have no learned held-out relation map; their heldout metric is N/A.
The time grid and endpoint indices are shared schema; the full time grid metadata is included in every serialized payload.

amendments.reason: Implementation audit added the native shared-basis coefficient-conditioning control so Mirror is compared both with a direct state-conditioned FMM map and an ordinary two-time coefficient network over the same physical basis.
amendments.protocol_effect: Adds a native conditioning control only; data, held-out intervals, metrics, tuning space, thresholds and fresh seeds unchanged.

amendments.reason: Cache deterministic RK4 reference maps by world seed to avoid recomputing the exact same target maps for each model/control.
amendments.protocol_effect: Execution-time optimization only; generated values, training samples, seeds, models, metrics and gate values remain unchanged.
